items: Majors: Computer Science B.A. and Managment B.S.

about: I am an undergraduate student at Boston College, graduating in 2026. I study Computer Science and Management. Also, I have a concentration in Management and Leadership in the Carroll School of Management. I most enjoys the intersections of technology and humanity, especially with UI/UX and product management. My coursework includes Business Statistics, Financial Accounting, Computer Organization, Algorithms, Fundamentals of Finance, Computer Systems, Web Application Development, Information Systems, Database Management Systems, Leadership, Operations Management, Computer Networks, and IOS Development.

At BC, I am a trip leader for Outdoor Adventures where I plan and lead trips for other students. Currently, I work for multiple institutions including SciSure, the Scouts BSA, and Boston College's Recreation Center. At SciSure, I works as a customer service associate. With the Scouts, I work as a climbing instructor. At BC's Rec Center, I work as a route setter.
